claims.statement: Enea Silvio Piccolomini, a humanist who tried to organise a crusade after the fall of Constantinople. Died at Ancona and was succeeded by Paul II.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard papal chronologies.
